page.notes: The initial quotation marks („) at the start of each line are printed and are kept as they stand. The word "statim" and "est" use long s, rendered here as plain s in roman; "patefacta est" is italic. The hyphen in "præ-cisè" and similar line-end breaks are printed hyphens. Lines beginning "„" are continuation marks of a quotation; "one" at the lower right is a catchword.
